nodes.label: fs-ops Helper Catalog
nodes.rationale: Injectors share one helper library (../fs-ops) for file, TOML, env, and endpoint operations instead of reimplementing them, keeping config edits consistent and merge-safe.

nodes.label: ToolInjector Interface
nodes.rationale: Every CLI tool injector must implement the same four-method interface (getStatus, apply, reset, download) with a toolId, so the console can drive any tool uniformly. Exported as a const named xxxInjector.

nodes.label: ToolStatus Shape
nodes.rationale: Status reports installed/configured state plus sanitized current settings; API keys are always prefix-only, never the full secret.

nodes.label: Nine Injector Implementation Rules
nodes.rationale: Merge-don't-overwrite protects user settings; reset removes only wokroute-injected fields; download never writes to disk; type-only imports and no dynamic imports keep the bundle analyzable; provider name is 'wokroute' not '9router'.

nodes.label: wokroute Provider Naming Rule
nodes.rationale: Provider name in all generated tool configs must be 'wokroute', explicitly NOT '9router' — prevents brand confusion in downstream tool UIs.
